jobs.description_text: Arvinas is a biotechnology company dedicated to improving the lives of patients suffering from debilitating and life-threatening diseases through the discovery, development, and commercialization of therapies that degrade disease-causing proteins. Arvinas uses its proprietary PROTAC Discovery Engine platform to engineer PROteolysis TArgeting Chimeras, or PROTACs, that are designed to harness the body’s own natural protein disposal system to selectively and efficiently degrade and remove disease-causing proteins. This differentiated approach has enabled Arvinas to build a broad pipeline of investigational therapies across oncology and neurodegenerative diseases, including ARV-102, targeting LRRK2 for neurodegenerative diseases; ARV-806, targeting KRAS G12D for mutated cancers, including pancreatic, colorectal, and non-small cell lung cancers; ARV-393, targeting BCL6 for relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin Lymphoma; ARV-027, targeting the polyglutamine-expanded androgen receptor, or polyQ-AR, in skeletal muscle for spinal bulbar muscular atrophy; and vepdegestrant, targeting the estrogen receptor for patients with locally advanced or metastatic ER+/HER2- breast cancer. Building on its leadership in targeted protein degradation, Arvinas achieved a major milestone in May 2026 with the first-ever U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of a PROTAC protein degrader therapy. jobs.title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_text: 关于我们 AXQ 安贤投资 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。 岗位使命 作为 机器学习基础设施工程师（Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer） 你将参与建设 AXQ 面向量化研究与机器学习的计算和平台基础设施，与 Infrastructure 团队及研究、工程团队紧密合作，提升特征计算、模型训练、实验迭代与推理任务的效率和可靠性。 我们面向 PB 级数据处理与大规模机器学习训练场景，持续优化 GPU/CPU 计算资源、分布式计算、存储与数据访问、机器学习平台及开发者工具。 你将参与相关基础设施系统与平台工具的设计、开发与交付，帮助研究人员更高效地使用计算资源，让研究工作流具备可扩展、可复现、易使用和成本高效的特性。 主要职责 计算集群与任务调度 ：建设和优化 GPU/CPU 资源管理与任务调度系统，提高计算资源利用率和任务运行效率。 分布式训练与计算 ：支持多 GPU、多节点计算任务，优化数据加载、任务并行、节点通信与故障恢复。 数据访问与性能优化 ：优化大规模数据读取、缓存与存储访问，定位并改善计算、网络及 I/O 瓶颈。 机器学习平台与研究工具 ：开发任务提交、实验管理、开发环境及依赖管理工具，提升研究效率与可复现性。 训练与推理基础设施 ：支持模型训练、批量及在线推理任务的部署运行，完善版本管理、监控与故障恢复。 自动化与稳定性建设 ：建设自动化运维、监控告警、权限管理与资源配额能力，提升系统可靠性。 需求落地与使用体验 ：与研究和工程团队协作，将共性需求转化为易用、可复用的平台能力。 岗位要求 具备基础设施、平台工程、分布式系统、高性能计算或机器学习相关技术基础，能够参与模块设计、开发、部署与问题排查。 扎实的 Linux、网络、存储和操作系统基础，能够分析资源使用情况，定位性能与稳定性问题。 熟练掌握 Python、Go、C++、Rust、Java 等至少一门编程语言，具备良好的编码习惯和工程意识。 了解容器、任务调度与资源管理，了解或熟悉 Kubernetes、Slurm、Ray 或同类系统中的至少一种。 理解机器学习模型训练和推理的基本流程，有实际模型训练或相关项目经验，了解数据 I/O、计算资源和运行环境的要求。 了解 CI/CD、Infrastructure as Code、监控告警及自动化运维，重视系统的可观测性、可复现性与故障恢复能力。 具备良好的学习、沟通与协作能力，能够理解研究需求，分析技术取舍并推动方案落地。 加分项 有量化投资、对冲基金、机器学习平台或大规模研究计算平台经验。 有大规模特征工程、数据管道、分布式存储或 PB 级数据处理经验。 有模型服务、批量推理或在线推理基础设施建设经验。 有公有云、混合云资源管理与 GPU 成本优化经验。 有 GPU 集群建设、分布式训练性能调优经验，或熟悉 PyTorch Distributed、CUDA、RDMA 等相关技术。 熟悉 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI coding tools，并有将其融入开发流程或建设配套工具的实践。

jobs.title: Security Tooling Engineer II
jobs.description_text: WHY BOX NEEDS YOU Box is building the industry's most trusted, secure content and AI platform. Our Production Security Tools team is seeking a Security Tooling Engineer II with curiosity and a security mindset to help build and operate infrastructure security across our tooling stack, including monitoring, vulnerability scanning, data loss prevention (DLP), and hardening checks. In this role, you will implement and operate security tooling and controls under the guidance of senior engineers; collaborate with engineering, privacy, legal, and other security teams to reduce data exposure and configuration risk; and help keep Box's infrastructure secure-by-design and secure-by-default while enabling rapid, responsible product development and AI adoption. WHAT YOU'LL DO Deploy and help maintain cloud-native security tooling in our multi-cloud environment. Contribute to infrastructure and policy management using Terraform and Terragrunt, following team standards and module patterns. jobs.title: Senior HPC Developer - RDMA Networking
jobs.description_text: About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Systems Engineer – RDMA Networking & Storage to help build and optimize high-performance infrastructure for AI and HPC systems. You’ll work across RDMA networking and storage data paths , spanning compute hosts, NICs, DPUs, smart switches , storage systems, and the Linux software stack. The work includes RoCE networking, NVMe-over-Fabrics, congestion control, performance optimization, programmable network hardware, and debugging complex interactions across hardware and software. This role is ideal for an experienced systems engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware, diagnosing difficult performance problems, and building reliable systems where latency, throughput, and network behavior matter. What You’ll Do Design, build, and optimize high-performance RDMA networking and storage systems Work with RoCE, RDMA Verbs, and NVMe-over-Fabrics Develop systems that leverage DPUs, SmartNICs, and programmable switches for packet processing, telemetry, control, and data-path acceleration Develop and optimize software using queue pairs, completion queues, memory registration, zero-copy I/O, and other RDMA primitives Debug performance and reliability issues across applications, Linux kernel, drivers, NICs, DPUs, switches, and storage systems Analyze network and storage behavior including latency, throughput, queueing, congestion, packet loss, retransmissions, and flow control Develop mechanisms to improve network performance and congestion

jobs.description_text: About Beneficial Deployments Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. This is a partner-facing role: you'll support nonprofits, research institutes, academic medical centres and public-sector funders as they use Claude to get treatments to patients with rare and neglected diseases, where there is little or no commercial incentive to fund development. The role focuses on clinical development, where we think Claude can help these partners today. Trials in these diseases have small patient populations, investigator-led or nonprofit funding and little operational support, and they often stall on protocol quality, operational risk and site start-up. Claude can help teams design better trials and start them sooner. Much of this work is drug repurposing: testing new uses for approved, usually off-patent or generic medicines, whose known safety profiles can let a good hypothesis reach patients years sooner than a new molecule. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer (Java), mid to senior level, to join the Metadata Platform DB team.
